recent_items.description: Chapter 3: Of God's Decree Section 4 These Angels and Men thus predestinated, and fore-ordained, are particularly, and unchangeably designed; and their number so certain, and definite, that it cannot be either increased, or diminished.

recent_items.title: Puritan Catechism Q9
recent_items.description:
Q9. What is the work of creation? A. The work of creation is God's making all things of nothing, by the Word of his power, in six normal consecutive days, and all very good.
Scripture References: [1] Gen.1.1 [2] Heb.11.3 [3] Exod.20.11 [4] Gen.1.31

recent_items.title: Westminster Larger Catechism Q21
recent_items.description:
Q21. Did man continue in that estate wherein God at first created him? A. Our first parents being left to the freedom of their own will, through the temptation of Satan, transgressed the commandment of God in eating the forbidden fruit; and thereby fell from the estate of innocency wherein they were created.
Scripture References: [1] Gen.3.6-Gen.3.8,Gen.3.13, Eccl.7.29, 2Cor.11.3

recent_items.title: Heidelberg Catechism Q14
recent_items.description:
Q14. Can any mere creature pay for us? A. No. In the first place, God will not punish another creature for the sin which man has committed. Furthermore, no mere creature can sustain the burden of God's eternal wrath against sin and deliver others from it.
Scripture References: [1] Ezek.18.4,Ezek.18.20, Heb.2.14-Heb.2.18 [2] Ps.130.3, Nah.1.6

recent_items.title: Waldensian Confession Art.2
recent_items.description: Article 2: Article 2 We do believe that there is one God, Father, Son, & Holy Ghost.

recent_items.title: Second Helvetic Confession Ch.7 Sec.1
recent_items.description: Chapter 7: Of The Creation of All Things: Of Angels, the Devil, and Man Section 1 GOD CREATED ALL THINGS This good and almighty God created all things, both visible and invisible, by his co-eternal Word, and preserves them by his co-eternal Spirit, as David testified when he said: "By the word of the Lord the heavens were made, and all their host by the breath of his mouth" (Ps. 33:6). And, as Scripture says, everything that God had made was very good, and was made for the profit and use of man. Now we assert that all those things proceed from one beginning.

recent_items.title: Westminster Shorter Catechism Q12
recent_items.description: Q12. What special act of providence did God exercise toward man in the estate wherein he was created? A. When God had created man, he entered into a covenant of life with him, upon condition of perfect obedience; forbidding him to eat of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, upon pain of death.

recent_items.title: Westminster Confession of Faith Ch.3 Sec.6
recent_items.description:
Chapter 3: Of God's Eternal Decree Section 6 As God hath appointed the elect unto glory, so hath he, by the eternal and most free purpose of his will, fore-ordained all the means thereunto.[1] Wherefore they who are elected, being fallen in Adam, are redeemed by Christ,[2] are effectually called unto faith in Christ by his Spirit working in due season; are justified, adopted, sanctified,[3] and kept by his power through faith unto salvation.[4] Neither are any other redeemed by Christ, effectually called, justified, adopted, sanctified, and saved, but the elect only.[5]
Scripture References: [1] Eph.1.4-Eph.1.5, Eph.2.10, 2Thess.2.13, 1Pet.1.2 [3] Rom.8.30, Eph.1.5, 2Thess.2.13 [2] 1Thess.5.9-1Thess.5.10, Titus.2.14 [5] John.6.64-John.6.65, John.8.47, John.10.26, John.17.9, Rom.8.28-Rom.8.39, 1John.2.19 [4] 1Pet.1.5

recent_items.title: First Confession of Basel Art.II
recent_items.description:
Article II: CONCERNING MAN We confess that in the beginning God made man faultless in the likeness of righteousness and holiness. But he willfully fell into sin. Through this fall the whole human race was corrupted and made subject to damnation. Moreover, our nature was enfeebled and became so inclined to sin that, unless it is restored by the Spirit of God, man neither does nor wants to do anything good of himself.[1]
Scripture References: [1] Gen.1.26, Eph.4.21, Gen.8.6, Gen.5.3, Rom.5.12,Rom.5.15, 1Cor.15.21, Eph.2.1, Gen.6.5, Gen.8.21, John.3.3, Rom.3.10,Rom.3.23, Ps.143.2,Ps.143.10, Eph.2.1
